title: Marshawn Kneeland, Cowboys player who died by suicide at 24, diagnosed with CTE

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Marshawn Kneeland, Cowboys player who died by suicide at 24, diagnosed with CTE
sources.description: Marshawn Kneeland's family said his posthumous CTE diagnosis provides "important context." Kneeland died by suicide at 24 years old in November 2025.
